text:
JUST LOOK AT THE GAME ASTRA MADE FOR ME

I asked ChatGPT-6 Astra to make Jelly Bowling - and now I have a full bowling game in my browser: a squishy jelly ball, colorful soft pins, collision physics, 10-frame scoring, strikes, and spares

You can pull the ball with your mouse, aim, and let it fly. The pins squash, scatter, and keep wobbling after every hit

For me, Astra is the strongest model right now. This is no longer just “make me a website” - it’s one prompt → a finished game I actually want to keep playing
